settings.signOutNothing: Nothing is waiting to be sent.

rejected.title: Refused entries
rejected.note: The server refused them, so they are no longer waiting. Enter them again if you need to.

reasons.too_many_sets: More than 150 sets in the session
reasons.wrong_measure: Counted in reps for a timed exercise, or the other way round
reasons.plan_shrank: Fewer exercises than the stored session (an exercise is never removed)

settings.title: Settings
settings.signOutFailed: Couldn't sign you out. Check your connection and try again.
settings.signOutPending_one: {{count}} entry not sent yet: it will go at your next sign-in on this device.
settings.signOutPending_other: {{count}} entries not sent yet: they will go at your next sign-in on this device.
settings.signOutUnknown: Some entries may not have been sent yet: they will go at your next sign-in on this device.

profile.lead: Everything is optional. Each piece of information only serves the tools listed under it.
profile.title: Profile
profile.rangeLead: Per week, as a % of your average weight. Used to say “in your range” on Body.
profile.rangeNote: Adjustable from 0.25 to 1%. Published recommendations stop at 1%: the app offers no more.

supplementsPage.title: My supplements
supplementsPage.name: Supplement name
supplementsPage.nameError: Between 1 and 40 characters, on one line.
supplementsPage.duplicate: This supplement is already on your list.
supplementsPage.empty: No supplements on your list yet.
supplementsPage.note: Belay notes what you take, with no dose advice. Daily reminders will come with notifications.

intake.kcalOutOfRange: Enter a whole number between 0 and 10,000 kcal.
intake.proteinOutOfRange: Enter a whole number between 0 and 500 g.
intake.note: One total per day, not food by food.

chart.summary: Weigh-ins from {{from}} to {{to}}. 7-day average: {{average}}. Loss per week: {{loss}}.
chart.hint: Left and right arrows: day by day. Enter: edit the weigh-in.

measures.title: Measurements
measures.waistHint: At the navel for the male formula, at the narrowest for the female formula.
measures.neckHipHint: Neck and hips are used by the Body fat tool.
measures.outOfRange: Enter between {{min}} and {{max}} cm, to the tenth.

annotation.title: Annotation
annotation.legend: Deload week · diet break · free note
annotation.label: Text (optional)
annotation.creatineNote: Creatine needs no annotation: it comes from the supplements you tick.

body.creatineNote: During the 14 days of creatine, the weight often rises by 1 to 2 kg of water: it isn't fat.
body.title: Body
body.signedOut: Tracking your weigh-ins needs an account. The tools work without one.
body.firstDaysBody: The 7-day average appears from 4 weigh-ins in 7 days, and the loss per week after two complete weeks. A single day's weight varies too much to say anything.

prefill.proposal: Your profile says {{profile}}. Update your profile with {{value}}?

program.editNote: The program's exercises are edited on a computer.
program.sheetNote: One tap makes it active and closes. Creating, renaming or deleting a program happens on a computer.
program.aside: Set aside · out of the rotation

rhythm.title: Program rhythm
rhythm.rotationNote: Sessions follow one another in order, whatever the day. No rest day planned.
rhythm.proposed: Suggested from your last weeks. One tap changes a day.
rhythm.needOne: Pick at least one session day.

history.signedOut: Your sessions are kept with an account. The program and the exercises need none.
history.first: Your first session will show here.
history.firstHow: It shows up on its own when you finish a session, or with “Log a session”.
history.removeBody: Its sets will leave the history and the statistics, on all your devices.

log.sub: done without the app, on another day
log.title: Log a session

session.pausedBody: The timer starts again as soon as you log a set.
session.finishAll_one: {{count}} set logged out of {{total}}; your program doesn't change.
session.finishAll_other: {{count}} sets logged out of {{total}}; your program doesn't change.
session.finishLeft_one: The unticked set won't be saved;
session.finishLeft_other: The {{count}} unticked sets won't be saved;
session.deleteBody_one: The logged set won't be kept; your program doesn't change.
session.deleteBody_other: The {{count}} logged sets won't be kept; your program doesn't change.
session.emptyBody: If you leave, this session won't be kept. You can start it later.
session.noClimbing: No climbing this week: vertical pull and curl added at the end of the session.

picker.note: For this session only: the program does not change.

preview.note: The program is edited on a computer. During a session you can replace an exercise or add a set.
preview.aside: Set aside · out of the rotation

activitySheet.title: Activity
activitySheet.runsOutOfRange: Enter a whole number between 0 and 200.
activitySheet.stepsNote: Copy them from your phone or your watch.
activitySheet.stepsOutOfRange: Enter a whole number between 0 and 100,000.

editor.note: Correcting changes only what you edit; the records are worked out again.
editor.incomplete: Fill in or remove the sets left incomplete.

tools.title: Tools
tools.lead: Everything is calculated on your device. Nothing is sent.

plates.name: Plates
plates.hint: What to load on the bar

protein.name: Protein
protein.hint: Your range per day and per meal

projection.name: Projection
projection.hint: When you could reach your goal

bmi.name: BMI
bmi.hint: Your place on the WHO ranges

body-fat.name: Body fat
body-fat.hint: An estimate from a tape measure

science.title: How it's calculated
science.thirdParty: Read on a third-party copy, not the official host.

range.current: Your value is in this range: {{range}}, {{label}}.

oneRepMax.lead: Your max from a set taken close to failure.
oneRepMax.oneRep: With 1 rep, your 1RM is the load you lifted.
oneRepMax.lessReliable: Beyond 10 reps, the estimate is less reliable.

plates.lead: What to put on each side of the bar.
plates.unreachable: {{target}} {{unit}} can't be loaded with your equipment.

equipment.title: My equipment
equipment.presetNote: “Edit” copies this preset into “Custom”: presets never change.
equipment.lbNote: In pounds, Belay uses a 45 lb bar and standard plates.
equipment.copied: Copied from “{{preset}}”. Tap a plate to add or remove it.
equipment.customNote: Tap a plate to add or remove it.

warmup.lead: Your warm-up sets, rounded to your equipment.
warmup.lightWork: Your working load is the bar alone or lighter: there is no warm-up to work out.
warmup.note: Loads are rounded to your equipment (“{{preset}}”). No study sets a single scheme: this is a common progression, adjust it as you like.

energy.lead: Your resting metabolism and what you burn in a day.

very-sedentary.name: Very sedentary
very-sedentary.description: Seated most of the day, little walking.

active.name: Active
active.description: Sedentary, plus about one hour of moderate to vigorous exercise a day.

very-active.name: Very active
very-active.description: Hard physical work or exercise for much of the day.

energy.note: An estimate within about ±10%: roughly 1 person in 5 is more than 10% away from their measured value. It's a starting point that your weigh-ins and intake will refine later.

protein.lead: A range per day and per meal, for your goal.
protein.perKg: that is {{low}} to {{high}} g per kg of body weight
protein.leanMass: When cutting, the range starts from your lean mass: 2.3 to 3.1 g per kg of lean mass.
protein.noBodyFat: Without a body-fat value, Belay uses 1.8 to 2.5 g per kg of body weight (Belay heuristic). Add your body fat for a closer range.
protein.floor: Raised to 1.6 g per kg of body weight, the floor Belay keeps when cutting (Belay heuristic).

projection.lead: When you could reach your goal, as a range of dates.
projection.weeks: In {{low}} to {{high}} weeks. Loss slows down as you lose weight, hence a range.
projection.notBelow: The projection works out a weight loss; your goal is already reached or above your current weight.
projection.above1: In athletes, a pace of about 1% per week came with less lean-mass gain (Garthe 2011). Source in the sheet.
projection.above15: At this pace, Belay suggests being followed by a doctor or a dietitian.

bmi.lead: Your body mass index, placed on the WHO ranges.

sentence.reference: In the WHO reference range ({{low}} to {{high}}).
sentence.above: Above the WHO reference range ({{low}} to {{high}}).
sentence.well-above: Well above the WHO reference range ({{low}} and over).

bmi.professional: If you have questions about your weight, talk to a health professional.
bmi.note: BMI doesn't tell muscle from fat: it's a population marker, not a diagnosis.

bodyFat.lead: An estimate from a tape measure, with published reference values.
bodyFat.bias: It tends to overestimate lean people and underestimate people with more body fat.
bodyFat.invalidMale: Your waist must be larger than your neck.
bodyFat.invalidFemale: Waist plus hips must be larger than your neck.
bodyFat.outOfRange: These measurements fall outside what the formula can handle. Check them.

bands.well-above: Matches a BMI of 30 and over

caption.standard: For the {{formula}} formula, ages {{from}} to {{to}} (Gallagher 2000, table 4).
caption.asian: For the {{formula}} formula, ages {{from}} to {{to}}, people of Asian origin (Gallagher 2000, table 5).

bodyFat.noReferences: The published reference values cover ages 20 to 79, so only the estimate is shown for your age.
bodyFat.referenceNote: “Asian” uses Gallagher's table 5, built from people living in Japan. This choice stays on your device.

instance.title: Your instance
instance.intro: The Belay server someone hosts for you, or that you host yourself. Enter its address.
instance.label: Instance address
instance.invalid: This address isn’t valid. Example: belay.example.org
instance.insecure: The address must start with https://
instance.notBelay: No Belay instance answers at this address. Check it.
instance.unreachable: Can’t reach this address. Check it, or check that the instance is up to date.
instance.offline: No connection. Try again once you’re online.

signIn.intro: Sign in to find your sessions and tracking on this phone.

health.title: Apple Health
health.intro: Belay adds your finished sessions and your weigh-ins to the Health app on this iPhone.
health.switchSub: Sent to Health as soon as they are saved
health.pendingDetail: Health was not available. Trying again next time you open Belay.
health.refusedDetail: Health does not let Belay write.
health.refusedHelp: Allow it in the Health app › your picture › Privacy › Apps › Belay, then try again.
health.importSub: From a connected scale or entered in Health
health.importNote: If no weigh-in arrives, check that Belay can read weight in the Health app › your picture › Privacy › Apps › Belay.
health.historySub: Your {{sessions}} and {{weighings}} from before you turned this on. Nothing is sent twice.
health.footerSets: Sets, loads and reps stay in Belay: Health has no place for them.
health.footerWatch: If another app (your watch, for instance) already recorded the workout, Belay does not add a second one.
health.footerOff: Turning this off removes nothing from Health: delete what is there in the Health app.
health.consentBody: Weigh-ins Health receives from other apps and devices will be added to Belay and synced with <host>{{host}}</host>. Only the first weigh-in of each day is kept, and a weigh-in already in Belay is never replaced.
